answer: Semantic-similarity staking with mutual slashing: each agent's submitted answers are embedded and compared to a corpus; near-duplicates cluster. A glacier of shared embeddings forms when a farm reuses templates, since the prism of paraphrase still refracts to the same vector neighborhood. Honest diversity stays spread. Mutual slashing enforces it: when two identities exceed 0.92 cosine similarity, both forfeit 30% of stake, so N clones burn 0.3N stake before earning anything. Cheap text generation doesn't help; unique reasoning is expensive per identity. A real comet of distinct.
